newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Nam Fatt plans 400 mln rgt bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Nam Fatt plans 400 mln rgt bond issue.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Nam Fatt Corp Bhd has proposed issuing 400 million ringgit worth of 3.0 percent unsecured guaranteed bonds with up to 119.50 million detachable warrants.
A statement issued by the company's bankers on Monday said the warrants would be offered to shareholders on the basis of five warrants for every four ordinary shares held.
Proceeds from the issue would be used to finance the acquisition of a 20 percent stake in a cement company, retire loan facilities and for working capital, it said.
Nam Fatt's paid-up capital will increase to 372.14 million ringgit upon full exercise of the warrants.
